text:
maya: heads up — trying to onboard hf model `stellara-large` and running into a mess around trust_remote_code + tokenizer special tokens. need eyes.
ryan: curious — what's failing exactly? model won't convert?
maya: conversion finishes but tokenization + chat template are inconsistent. examples get split into unexpected tokens and some special markers like <|SYS|> become multiple tokens.
sofia: do we have a config.json from HF? sometimes model_type is custom which triggers trust_remote_code loading custom classes.
maya: yes, config.json has \"model_type\": \"stellara_arch\" and repo needs `trust_remote_code=True` to load `StellaraConfig`/`StellaraTokenizer`. we didn't allow that in auto_map so it fell back to a generic tokenizer.
ryan: ah — fallback tokenizer will often not map special_tokens correctly. can you paste the tokenizer.json snippet?
maya: 
```
"special_tokens_map": {
  "bos_token": "<|BOS|>",
  "eos_token": "<|EOS|>",
  "additional_special_tokens": ["<|USR|>", "<|SYS|>"]
}
```
maya: but HF tokenizer class overrides `unique_no_split_tokens` to treat `<|SYS|>` as single token. our fallback doesn't, so `<|SYS|>` -> `<|`, `SYS`, `|>` tokens.
ci-bot: convert-job #459 queued by maya — huggingface->redwood conversion started
ryan: this explains the quality regression we saw in chat evals — prefix tokens get mangled so prompts are semantically different.
alex: what's the immediate workaround? allow trust_remote_code for this repo?
sofia: we can, but trust_remote_code pulls arbitrary python. for enterprise/private we need a manual review. alternative is to extract special token list + unique tokens and bake into Redwood tokenizer override.
jake: i've done that before — add a small `tokenizer_overrides.json` alongside model artifacts with `unique_no_split_tokens` and `special_tokens_map` and ensure runtime loader picks it up before fallback.
maya: tried that — when quantizing we also saw a mismatch: 8-bit quantization changed the embeddings for those special tokens because the mapping indices differed after conversion.
ryan: did indices change? maybe we appended tokens in a different order
maya: yes, HF added extra unused tokens at the end (`<|PAD_X|>`) and our tokenizer stripped duplicates differently. index_shifts were +3 for all subsequent tokens.
alex: urgent: we need a small reproducible test and a checklist entry. propose: (1) detect `model_type` unknown -> flag as requires_review, (2) when trust_remote_code is required, fetch `tokenizer_config.json` and `special_tokens_map` and validate tokenization of a short set including special markers, (3) if indices differ, emit a mapping patch and re-run quantization with pinned indices.
sofia: agree. also add an automated unit test in onboarding that tokenizes these examples and checks roundtrip: decode(encode(text)) preserves markers.
jake: i'll draft the tokenizer_overrides schema. sample:
```
{
  "additional_special_tokens": ["<|USR|>", "<|SYS|>"],
  "unique_no_split_tokens": ["<|SYS|>"]
}
```
maya: thanks. i'll attach the failing reproducer in the ticket. reproducer is small: load hf repo with trust_remote_code, dump `vocab.json` + `tokenizer_config.json`, then load via redwood fallback and diff token->index map.
ryan: estimate effort to fix and add tests?
maya: patch + tests ~0.5d, plus security review for trust_remote_code gating ~1d, plus update onboarding docs ~0.5d.
alex: ok assign to maya + jake for patch, sofia to own review gate. i'll file a tracking ticket and mark as blocker for stellara onboarding.
sofia: also ping legal for repo review if we decide to allow trust_remote_code for hosted customers.
maya: filing ticket now and dropping reproducer + test vectors.
ci-bot: ticket created: INF-847 (stellara tokenizer mapping + trust_remote_code checklist)
maya: thanks all :thumbsup:\n
